A_placebo.comparison: dR2(C3_hat) - dR2(C3_placebo), each beyond CTRL + IMPACT + VOLBENCH with symbol fixed effects, on the same rows and the same 2,000 date-block bootstrap draws; also each one's own dR2
A_placebo.placebo: C3_placebo = C3_hat from fit_t6 on the same window with the flow series circularly shifted by 180 minutes inside the 360-minute window; prices and depth unchanged
A_placebo.sanity: recomputed C3_hat must match the stored value (share of rows within 1e-6 relative)

B_guards.comparison: log TLR(robust_guard) - log TLR(rule) on the test hours, 2,000 date-block bootstrap draws, matched activity (positions normalized to training mean 1 per symbol and rule), k_s = symbol training median, risk measures winsorized at training 1%/99%; Holm across the four new comparisons within each sample

new_rules.margin_scan: q = min(1, k_s/SCAN), SCAN = 99th percentile of |60-minute log return| over the three certification days (an exchange-style scanning range, updated daily)
new_rules.participation: q = min(1, V6/k_s), V6 = dollar volume over the previous six hours
new_rules.peak_6h: q = min(1, k_s/(U6 * P60)), six-hour estimate (the peak-guard of Paper 2's theory, estimated)
new_rules.peak_cert: q = min(1, k_s/(U_cert * P60_cert)), P60_cert = max |impulse response| of the certified operator

B_guards.note: an inventory-only cap is a fixed position limit, identical to the static rule once activity is matched
